featureDescriptions.label: Replica reads
featureDescriptions.definition: Route read commands to replicas instead of the primary, spreading read load across the topology.

featureDescriptions.label: Retry & backoff
featureDescriptions.definition: Back off progressively instead of hammering a server that is overloaded or restarting, avoiding connection storms.

featureDescriptions.label: Pub/Sub
featureDescriptions.definition: Re-subscribe to channels and patterns automatically after a reconnect or topology change, so subscribers never go silently deaf.

featureDescriptions.label: SCAN family
featureDescriptions.definition: Iterate keys consistently across every shard, tracking slot migrations that happen mid-scan.

featureDescriptions.label: Low-latency
featureDescriptions.definition: Send reads to whichever replica is currently answering fastest, measured by the client itself.

featureDescriptions.label: AZ affinity
featureDescriptions.definition: Prefer replicas in the client’s own availability zone to cut cross-AZ latency and transfer cost.

featureDescriptions.label: Client-side caching
featureDescriptions.definition: Keep hot values in the application process and let the server invalidate them, removing a round trip entirely.

featureDescriptions.label: Advanced capabilities
featureDescriptions.definition: Announce client capabilities so the server can hand off slot redirections cleanly during upgrades and failover.

featureDescriptions.label: Connection pooling
featureDescriptions.definition: Reuse a pool of established connections rather than dialing one per command.
